coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your north star is payment success rate, and every slow or unreliable call in the payment path pulls it down. At Lumen Payments I faced a similar problem when the payment status API was slow under load. I moved the hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and brought p99 latency from 480 ms down to 120 ms.

That work sat inside eleven years of backend engineering on payment and event-processing services. As a Senior Software Engineer at Lumen Payments (fintech), I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, which is the service-oriented architecture work your team describes. I owned those services in production, was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents. I haven't written production Go; my depth is in Kotlin, Java and Python, and I pick up new backend languages quickly. I also bring API design, code review, Datadog monitoring and AWS experience to your goal of turning the payments stack into a self-serve, API-driven platform.

I took a career break from 2023 to 2025 to care for a family member, and I'm now returning to full-time engineering. I'm available to start promptly and would welcome a conversation about how I can help your Payments team raise payment success rate.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Coinbase Payments hiring team,

You're hiring for backend services that move money reliably, and at Lumen Payments I designed and ran a high-volume settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot on Kafka. I also led a team of engineers through a migration from a monolith to services and was on call for the payments platform, so I know both service-oriented design and owning code in production. My CV and cover letter are attached for more detail. I'm back in full-time engineering and available for a call any weekday this week.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
